item.title: Minneapolis nurses hold vigil for Alex Pretti after fatal shooting
item.description: A prayer vigil took place Wednesday night at 26th and Nicollet, where nurses gathered to honor Alex Pretti, an ICU nurse who was fatally shot by a Border Patrol agent on Jan. 24. Community gathers in supportThe street was packed with both nurses and non-nurses, all holding candles in memory of Pretti. item.title: Amy Klobuchar is running for Minnesota governor
item.description: U.S. Sen. Amy Klobuchar has made it official, and is running for governor of Minnesota after Gov. Tim Walz dropped out of the race earlier this month.
